description: Get The Durability Curve's record of AI model releases from ten labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Meta, xAI, Mistral, Alibaba, Moonshot, Zhipu): when each model came out, with the lab's own announcement as source; for models with a page, the API list prices read at the lab's pricing page on a stated day; for the frontier launches the Access Gap tracks, when ordinary people could first use it, in the app, on the cheapest paid plan and on the free plan, each with its source; and each lab's flagship price and free-plan answer. Search by model or lab name, or filter by lab, release date, frontier status or free-plan access. The record runs to data_through; a newer release is not in it yet. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

frontier_only.description: true: only the frontier releases the /chart/ page plots (models anyone could use on the date given).

lab.description: Only this lab, by name or short name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Meta, xAI, Mistral, Alibaba, Moonshot or Zhipu.

limit.description: How many models to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

on_free_plan.description: true: only models whose lab's free consumer plan includes them; false: only models the free plan is recorded as not including. A model whose free-plan access is unknown, unnamed or restricted is on neither list. Applies to the frontier launches the Access Gap tracks.

query.description: A model or lab name in plain words, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5", "GPT-6.1", "Gemini Flash" or "DeepSeek". Leave empty to list newest first.

released_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only models released after this day.

released_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only models released before this day.

name: get_ai_models
title: Get AI model facts
